title: hibbertia cuneiformis
intro: Hibbertia cuneiformis, commonly known as the Guinea flower, is a small, shrubby plant native to Australia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it useful in the treatment of various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hibbertia cuneiformis include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
